value.rationale: The work gives a concrete, cost-neutral remedy for a documented mean-square stability deficit without changing either one-step random stage marginal; all dissipative scalar modes become pathwise contracting at completed pairs, whereas iid stages blow up in mean square for every imaginary mode. Uniqueness among all centered samplewise A-stable two-stage couplings establishes a structural classification rather than an isolated numerical witness. Applicability is explicitly limited to the linear test equation.
